note: Every data source of the twin. kind: real | estimated | simulated | restricted. Endpoints were tested on 2026-11-13 unless status says otherwise.

roma_geoserver.what: PRG, Carta per la Qualita, Rete Ecologica, UNESCO, schools, hospitals, municipi, sports facilities
roma_geoserver.licence: not stated in capabilities; credit Roma Capitale - GeoPortale (CC BY assumed, confidence 60)

lazio_geoserver.what: PTPR Tavola A/B, Natura 2000, AGEA orthophotos

osm.what: Roads, POIs, playgrounds, care homes, masts, private sports venues
osm.status: not tested from the research sandbox

mase_lidar.what: 1 m surface and terrain models (2008-2011), about a third of the centre along the Tiber

megascenes.what: About 896 Rome landmark photo scenes with camera poses
megascenes.redistribution: derived models with attribution; not raw photos

eea_hourly.what: Hourly air quality, 13 Rome NO2 points

roma_ckan.what: 365 open datasets (Wi-Fi sessions, accidents, sports centres 2018...)
roma_ckan.licence: mostly CC BY; exclude the 11 non-commercial ones

cartoradio_grid.what: National estimated E-field grid in V/m, 100 m cells (EPSG:3857), float32, nodata -9999
cartoradio_grid.access: cloud-optimised GeoTIFF, read the Rome window by byte range at runtime
cartoradio_grid.licence: legal notes forbid reuse; written consent from MIMIT/FUB pending (cartoradio@fub.it)

sim_loops.what: Road loop stations (flow, speed, occupancy) at 93 centrally controlled signals on major roads

sim_register.what: Antenna installation register seeded from OpenCelliD and OSM
sim_register.licence: inherits CC BY-SA / ODbL from its seeds
sim_register.status: removed 2026-11-13 (rule: only road loops are simulated)

sim_emf_points.status: removed 2026-11-13 (rule: only road loops are simulated)

sim_applications.status: removed 2026-11-13 (rule: only road loops are simulated)

roma_gtfs_rt_trip_updates.what: Bus/tram trip updates (delay at next stop)

eea_station_metadata.what: EEA sampling point and station coordinates (join on station EoI code)

roma_semafori.what: Traffic signals with control system (seed for simulated loop positions)
roma_semafori.licence: credit Roma Capitale - GeoPortale (CC BY assumed, C=60); road geometry OSM-derived (ODbL)

est_register.what: Antenna sites: OpenCelliD clusters + OSM masts + Cartoradio peaks, effective EIRP fitted to the Cartoradio grid
est_register.licence: derived from CC BY-SA / ODbL / Cartoradio (restricted)

arpa_points.what: ARPA Lazio EMF measurements at addresses (art. 14 L. 36/2001)
arpa_points.licence: Roma Capitale open data, credit ARPA Lazio

cams_open_meteo.what: CAMS Europe air-quality model (NO2, PM10, PM2.5)

roma_wifi.what: Roma Capitale public Wi-Fi (DigitRoma) anonymised sessions, counted per hotspot and hour
roma_wifi.endpoint: https://dati.comune.roma.it (CKAN datasets wifi<year>, hotspot maps D.192)
roma_wifi.access: no key; one CSV per day, about one day behind
roma_wifi.status: verified 2026-11-13; DOMAIN, LOGINCOUNT, traffic and language dropped at parse

mim_school_buildings.what: School building register (which school buildings have a gym), for the sports add-on

sports_web_enrichment.what: Facility candidates and fields (disciplines, hours, accessibility, organisational contacts) found on the web by the sports scout and enrichment agents (Exa), each with source URL, retrieval date and confidence; labelled 'from the web, unverified'
sports_web_enrichment.licence: facts with source links; page text is not stored beyond a short quote

open_meteo_forecast.what: Hourly rain, 10 m wind and 2 m temperature forecasts (ICON-2I, fallback ICON-EU)
open_meteo_forecast.access: no key; free tier is rate-limited per IP (the shared cloud egress hit the daily limit on 2026-11-13)

glofas_flood.what: Daily river discharge, Tiber at Ripetta and Aniene at Lunghezza (GloFAS)

copernicus_hrl_tree_cover.what: Tree Cover Density 2018, 20 m, 0-100 % (Copernicus HRL), Rome window; heatwave scenario
copernicus_hrl_tree_cover.licence: Copernicus free and open data policy

istat_census_ages.what: Residents aged 65+ and 75+ per 2021 census section (P27+P28+P29, P29); heatwave scenario

acea_sewer_outfalls.what: ACEA ATO2 sewer outfall points on the Tiber basin (280); rain flood river backflow
acea_sewer_outfalls.access: GeoJSON download, no key; host blocked from the cloud sandbox, fetched via Modal (scripts/fetch_sewer_layers.py)

roma_sewer_design_rules.what: Comune di Roma (Dip. XII, 2000) sewer sizing rules and design rain curve, used as parameters in config/scenarios.yaml
roma_sewer_design_rules.access: PDF, read once; numbers copied to config with a basis note
